records.text: keeping an eye on willow partners this week

records.subject: How's the first week going?
records.body:
Hi Ines,

Good to see Willow Partners has a real project going. Let me know if you want a second pair of eyes on how it's structured.

Cheers,
Priya Chen

records.subject: A better way to track team projects
records.body:
Hi Ines,

If you haven't had a chance to set up your first project yet, now's a great time -- it's the quickest way to see what Wrenfield is for.

Warmly,
Elena Kelly

records.subject: Welcome aboard, Willow Partners
records.body:
Hi Ines,

Welcome to Wrenfield. If you're bringing a team along, a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time, and seats can be added any time from Account Settings.

I'm around if you need anything.

Cheers,
Priya Chen

decisions.rationale: Project created day 0 (fast start) but no key milestone in 6 days, no invites, zero replies to three outreach emails (email:6f9f2955, dcfee1ec, eac084ba) and no tickets. Silent single-admin Starter accounts rarely self-activate, though 8 days remain and the project exists.

draft.subject: A quick next step on your Willow Partners project
draft.body:
Hi Ines,

Nice work getting your first project going in Wrenfield. In Wrenfield, projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, so adding the first few tasks to that project is usually the fastest way to see it working for the team.

If it's useful, I'm happy to hop on a short call this week and go through that first step with you 
invite a teammate from Account Settings -> Members whenever you're ready.

Best,
Priya
